title: Asewinjo kuom piny
author: Where we'll never grow old
stanzas: Asewinjo kuom piny man mabor loka nam, En kar dak maber mar jo mo war;
Yesu e moloso udi mag dalano, En piny ma ok wanabed moti.
E dalano maber ma ok wanalalie, Wanabedi gi mor gi lala;
Wanapak Ruoth Yesu e piny Ruoth mochwere, Piny ma ok wanathoe kendo.
Ka tichwa orumo kwaseyudo `simbo, Masiche ok nobedie kendo;
Yuak gi tem norum chuth, wanawer gi jogo, Mosekwongonwa dhiyo kuno.
chorus: Wanasiki, wanasiki, E pinyno ma tho ok nobedi
Wanasiki, wanasiki, E pinyno ma tho ok nobedie.
